description: This file defines the HashingStream class, which decorates a PSR-7 StreamInterface to compute a hash of the stream data as it is read. It provides methods for reading data, seeking, and invokes a callback upon completion of hash calculation.

classes.name: HashingStream
classes.description: A stream decorator that calculates a rolling hash as data is read from the stream.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a HashingStream with a given stream, hash, and optional completion callback.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream, updates the hash, and invokes callback if EOF is reached.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Resets the hash if seeking to the beginning of the stream.
